title: What is Road Rehabilitation?
summary: Learn what road rehabilitation is, how the rehabilitation process works, and the differences between rehabilitation, maintenance, and reconstruction.
body_markdown:
Road rehabilitation is critical for keeping the world moving—from drivers to bikers and pedestrians—safely and efficiently. When the impacts of extreme weather, vehicle accidents or normal wear and tear begin to disrupt travelers, road rehabilitation is a minimally invasive method that focuses on improving roadway damage faster than a full restoration project would allow.


While rehabbing timelines will depend on factors like location, weather and the extent of roadway damage, road rehabilitation projects tend to run for about 10 days to a month, and most contractors follow a general guideline to assess the rehabilitation needs of a road, barring major incidents that demand immediate action, about every 10-15 years.


Whether the project is scheduled in advance or pops up due to circumstances out of contractors’ control, Kennametal has a[complete lineup of tooling and wear solutions](https://www.kennametal.com/us/en/products/construction/road-rehabilitation.html?query=:relevance:obsoleteFacet:false:allCategoriesKMT:61202302&sort=&pageSize=16&category=61202302&uom=inch) designed for taking on the most demanding road rehabilitation applications.
